name: Shiraishi Aoi
source:
A second-year high school student who helps handle announcements for the student council.

She was left in charge of the school's social media, working closely with Natori, Hazuki, and Mikami.

Since she has no experience, she's worried about being given such a big role.

"I was surprised that they gave me this job, but I plan to do my best."

(Translated from official website)
